title: Paycor - All-in-one HCM for 10-1,000 employee businesses, now owned by Paychex
clean_text: Paycor, headquartered in Cincinnati and offering cloud-based payroll, HR, and timekeeping since 1990, serves more than 30,000 businesses with an all-in-one HCM platform covering payroll, time and attendance, talent management (applicant tracking, performance evaluation with 360-degree feedback), and benefits administration. It particularly targets businesses with 10-1,000 employees, with industry-specific tools for healthcare, manufacturing, professional services, and restaurants. Paychex completed a $4.1 billion acquisition of Paycor in April 2025, making the two previously separate competitors part of the same parent company.

meta.target: businesses with 10-1,000 employees across multiple industry verticals
meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, base plus per-employee (now custom quote only)
